about_the_game:
Break into the dangerous underworld, keep moving forward in the underworld, and the devil will constantly summon various monsters to stop players. Players need to prepare weapon combinations in advance, summon and put away weapon groups at any time in the battle to deal with all crises.

The game will bring a real-time combat experience full of strategies.

————————————————————————————

It is a RogueLike game, with a wealth of different kinds of props, each of which will have a different experience.

There are many kinds of props: weapons, enchantments (enhanced weapons), passive items, amulets, consumables, etc. Their combination will form a variety of genres, which will bring a unique experience to each game.

————————————————————————————

  • There will be more than 30 kinds of BOSS.

  • There will be more than 60 weapons and more than 120 different props (they will have a lot of different combination effects)

  • There will be more than 9 different maps (including different monsters, level challenges, music, special BOSS battles …)

  • provide endless mode (there will be special props and weapons in endless mode! )
